policies.cover_summary: Third party, fire, theft and accidental damage for a 2019 Ford Focus used in the UK.

claims.summary: Windscreen chip on the driver's side.
Parking scrape on the rear bumper.

knowledge_passages.heading: Motor policy excess
knowledge_passages.body: The standard accidental damage excess is the amount shown on the schedule. Glass claims may use a lower glass excess. The customer chooses whether to proceed after the excess is explained. This passage is synthetic.

knowledge_passages.heading: What under review means
knowledge_passages.body: A claim marked under review is open. An assessor has the file and has not yet issued a decision. Status text is guidance. It does not authorise a payment or a repair. This passage is synthetic.

knowledge_passages.heading: Premium instalments
knowledge_passages.body: An unpaid instalment remains due until the customer pays it through the usual channels. This desk can show the amount and due date. It cannot take a payment. This passage is synthetic.

knowledge_passages.heading: Fleet excess
knowledge_passages.body: Fleet accidental damage excess is 5000 GBP. This other-tenant passage must never be returned for demo-motor searches. This passage is synthetic.
